versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the ESLint Config Generator skill.
- Generates optimal ESLint flat config based on detected framework, TypeScript usage, plugins, and project patterns.
- Supports migration from legacy .eslintrc formats to flat config.
- Recommends and tunes plugins and rules for code quality, accessibility, and best practices.
- Audits ESLint configuration for rule conflicts and upgrades configuration format compatibility.
